runsheet.short_description: Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but enjoy the performances --- you catch more issues this way. Use the provided headphones. Upon issues, use judgement: Either unmute to raise the issue, or contact the [[Zoom Master]] immediately by walking to them.
Monitor the Webinar and report issues immediately to [#vol-alerts](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CDNPPNJ0Z).
